payout_quote: Each time a Potential New Client becomes a new Acorns User using your personal invitation code or referral link that you shared with them during the Promotional Period in accordance with the eligibility criteria below, you will receive a $5 investment of Reward Shares in your Acorns Invest Account.
steps: Be an Acorns User with an open, active Acorns Invest Account in Good Standing
Copy your personal invitation code or referral link from the Acorns app or Acorns.com (Invite Friends)
Share it with friends; each friend must sign up for a first-time Acorns subscription and open an Acorns Invest Account using your code/link
Friend must complete an initial deposit or investment of $5 or more (excluding Round-Ups) from a linked bank account within 14 days after the promotional period, and keep the account in Good Standing
Acorns invests a $5 bonus of Reward Shares (ETF shares) into your Acorns Invest Account, typically 30-45 days after the friend's initial deposit settles
catches: Payout is NOT cash — it is a $5 investment of Reward Shares (ETF shares) in your Acorns Invest Account; no cash alternative
Friend must make a real $5+ initial investment from a linked bank account (gift cards excluded) within 14 days; accounts must stay in Good Standing
Program consists of limited-time promotional offerings — amounts and offers can change or be terminated by Acorns
No referral without prior express written consent for text/email outreach; no spam/mass-marketing of links
Rewards at Acorns' sole discretion; suspected fraud can lead to withholding or clawback
Both parties must be US legal residents 18+; referred friend must be a brand-new Acorns user
biggest_catch: The $5 per referral is paid as ETF shares inside your Acorns Invest Account, not cash — and only after your friend makes a real $5+ bank-funded investment.
eligibility: Existing Acorns users with an open, active Invest Account in Good Standing; referrals only to new-to-Acorns US residents 18+
timing: Reward Shares typically deposited within 30-45 days after the referred friend's initial deposit settles
